capabilities: Restyle the caret with shapes, colors, thickness, glow, blink and smooth movement
Animate typing and deleting with visual effects such as pop, typewriter, CRT and torch
Play typewriter and mechanical-keyboard sounds while typing
Give each Vim mode its own cursor and status bar indicator
Save cursor presets with share codes and roll random ones
disambiguation: Not a mouse-cursor tool; it styles only the text caret and the area around it while editing.
extras: Free and MIT with a donation request; effect sounds credit third-party recordings (Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, OmaVibes, Mechvibes, kbsim); settings localized to eleven languages; documentation includes reduced-motion and performance notes.
problem: Obsidian's text caret has a fixed look and no options for styling it or adding visual and audible feedback while typing.

relations.evidence: the engine has been carried to other editors and forked into new plugins

summary: Cursor customization plugin that restyles the text caret with shapes, colors, blinking, smooth movement, visual effects and typing sounds.
